privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page describes what personal data QuizOnline collects, how it is used and what rights you have. It is intentionally short and factual — reach out with any question.

sections.heading: Data collected
sections.body: User profile (name, e-mail, preferred language), domains and quizzes you participate in, notification preferences, and a moderation audit log. Authentication tokens are stored locally in your browser (localStorage / sessionStorage) — strictly necessary for the site to function.

sections.heading: Use of data
sections.body: Strictly to operate the service: authentication, invitation / notification e-mails, displaying results and moderation analytics. No data is sold or shared with third parties for advertising purposes.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: Data is kept while your account is active. Database backups are retained for 14 days and then pruned automatically.

sections.heading: Hosting and processors
sections.body: The application is hosted on AWS (EU region). E-mails go through the SMTP provider configured by the operator — no data is sent to third-party analytics services by default.

privacy.rightsBody: You have the right to access, rectify, port and erase your data. For access and portability, click the button below to download all your data as JSON. For erasure, contact us at the address below.
privacy.exportHint: Generates a ``quizonline-export-<your username>.json`` file with profile, domains, requests and quizzes.
privacy.contactBody: For any privacy-related question or to request account deletion, write to {email}.

features.title: Everything you need to build quizzes that matter
features.intro: From organisational structure to detailed results, QuizOnline brings content authoring, delivery and follow-up into a single product designed multilingual from the ground up.

domains.title: Organise your content by domain
domains.intro: Give each entity its own space, roles and rules. Domains structure the entire platform.

roles.title: Role hierarchy
roles.description: Owner, managers and members, each with permissions tuned to their level.

policies.title: Membership policies
policies.description: Three approval modes: automatic, owner-only, or owner-and-managers.

requests.title: Self-service join requests
requests.description: Full join workflow with approval, motivated rejection and status tracking.

bulkModeration.title: Bulk moderation
bulkModeration.description: Approve or reject many requests in a single atomic call, with focused audit logging.

multiInvite.title: Multi-domain invitations
multiInvite.description: Invite the same email address to several domains in one action, with per-domain authorization checks.

analytics.title: Moderation analytics
analytics.description: Counters, acceptance rate, median decision time and top moderators — computed in real time.

transferOwnership.title: Ownership transfer
transferOwnership.description: Hand a domain over to another user via a signed link, with no premature switchover.

auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.description: Immutable trail of every moderation decision and action, browsable per domain.

notifications.title: Email notifications
notifications.description: Owners and applicants kept informed at every step, in their own language.

multilingual.title: Multilingual by design
multilingual.description: Translatable name and description across five languages: FR, EN, NL, IT, ES.

aiTranslate.title: AI translations
aiTranslate.description: Pre-fill translations in one click thanks to the DeepL integration.

languageGate.title: Allowed languages
languageGate.description: Restrict authoring languages on a per-domain basis.

subjects.title: Categorise with flexibility
subjects.intro: Topics let you freely organise the themes that matter for each domain.

crud.title: Full management
crud.description: Create, edit and toggle topics scoped to a single domain.

multilingual.title: Multilingual content
multilingual.description: Translatable name and description in five languages.

tagging.title: Question linkage
tagging.description: Multi-topic tagging with custom ordering per topic.

autoCreate.title: Auto-created on import
autoCreate.description: Missing topics appear automatically during question import.

questions.title: An uncompromised question bank
questions.intro: From media-rich multiple-choice to teaching-grade explanations, every question speaks all your languages.

multipleChoice.title: Flexible multiple choice
multipleChoice.description: Single correct answer or several — you choose, per question.

multilingual.title: Multilingual content
multilingual.description: Title, description, explanation and answer options translated in five languages.

images.title: Embedded images
images.description: Upload with automatic deduplication; illustrate without inflating storage.

videos.title: Hosted video
videos.description: Upload video files attached straight to the question.

youtube.title: YouTube ready
youtube.description: Paste any URL — watch, shorts, embed, youtu.be — it gets normalized for you.

modes.title: Practice or exam
modes.description: Enable each question for practice, exam, or both pools.

explanations.title: Detailed explanations
explanations.description: Rich-text content shown after answering in practice mode.

aiTranslate.title: Batch translations
aiTranslate.description: DeepL translates title, description, explanation and options in a single call.

importExport.title: Structured import / export
importExport.description: Versioned JSON and CSV to migrate or archive your question bank.

duplicate.title: Duplication
duplicate.description: Clone an existing question to save time on variants.

quizzes.title: Deliver, time, follow up
quizzes.intro: Practice, exam or public assessment: every template combines your mode, duration and visibility rules.

modes.title: Practice and Exam
modes.description: Immediate feedback or single attempt with controlled reveal.

timer.title: Configurable timer
timer.description: Per-template duration with server-side automatic expiry.

window.title: Availability window
window.description: Date range, or permanent template — your choice.

visibility.title: Fine-grained visibility
visibility.description: Score and answer detail: immediate, scheduled, or never — each dimension is configurable independently.

notifyUnlock.title: Unlock notifications
notifyUnlock.description: Automatic email to participants when the result or detail visibility window opens, with a direct link to their session.

shuffle.title: Per-session shuffle
shuffle.description: Toggle on to give every participant a different order, deterministic per session (same order on every reload).

public.title: Public quizzes
public.description: Allow access without domain membership for open assessments.

assignment.title: Bulk assignment
assignment.description: Assign a template to many users in a single atomic call.

emails.title: Assignment emails
emails.description: Automatic notification with deadline and direct link, in the recipient's language.

messages.title: Contextual messaging
messages.description: Per-question alert threads — start a conversation during the quiz.

scoring.title: Weighted scoring
scoring.description: Per-question weight in a template, all-or-nothing on correct options.

pdf.title: PDF export
pdf.description: A4 result generation with score, per-question detail and explanations.

tracking.title: Session tracking
tracking.description: Per-template view with completion status per user.

learning.title: Courses, lessons and learning paths
learning.intro: Design full learning paths: sections, lessons, polymorphic blocks and controlled publishing — every course stays within your domain's languages.

catalog.title: Searchable catalog
catalog.description: Your learners browse courses by keyword, level and domain, with a preview card for each.

structure.title: Course → Sections → Lessons
structure.description: A clear hierarchy to organize paths: sections group lessons, lessons host the blocks.

blocks.title: 8 block types
blocks.description: Rich text, image, video, file, quiz, callout, code, iframe — each type has its dedicated editor.

editor.title: Drag-and-drop editor
editor.description: Reorder blocks in a lesson by drag-and-drop. Each block edits with an explicit Save / Cancel footer — no silent autosave. Same UX for sections and lessons inside a course.

calloutVariants.title: Callout variants
calloutVariants.description: Callout blocks carry a semantic variant (info / success / warning / error) that drives the left-border colour.

translations.title: Per-block translations
translations.description: Language tabs in every block editor, with a "translate from the active tab" button that fills blanks via DeepL.

viewAsLearner.title: View as learner
viewAsLearner.description: Eye toggle to preview a lesson exactly the way a student sees it, with all editing controls hidden.

publish.title: Publish, unpublish, clone
publish.description: Draft → published workflow, back to draft when needed, one-click clone to spin off a variant.

safeHtml.title: Sanitized HTML
safeHtml.description: Rich text runs through nh3 with a strict allowlist (Quill CSS allowed, scripts and exotic URLs scrubbed).

multilingual.title: Per-domain multilingual
multilingual.description: Course and translations are constrained to Domain.allowed_languages. No accidental language slips through.

enrollment.title: From sign-up to certificate
enrollment.intro: Three enrollment modes, lesson-by-lesson progress, validation quizzes and auto-issued PDF certificates — the full learner cycle.

invites.title: Email invitations
invites.description: Invite learners in bulk with a deadline and automatic reminder before expiry.

progress.title: Progress tracking
progress.description: Each completed lesson updates the course completion percentage, persisted per user.

validationQuiz.title: Validation quiz
validationQuiz.description: Attach a quiz to a lesson: until the passing score is reached, the lesson stays unvalidated.

finalQuiz.title: Final quiz + certificate
finalQuiz.description: Passing the final quiz triggers certificate issuance — passing threshold tunable by the instructor.

certificates.title: PDF certificates
certificates.description: Async PDF rendering via Celery + reportlab, with per-course sequential numbering.

certificateConfig.title: Configurable certificates
certificateConfig.description: Toggle issuance per course and set a validity in months. The expiration date is frozen at issue time.

verification.title: Public verification
verification.description: Every certificate has a public verification URL — signed, anti-tamper, anon-throttled.

emails.title: 5 localized emails
emails.description: Enrollment created, approved, rejected, course completed, certificate issued — each translated to FR/EN/NL/IT/ES via gettext.

analytics.title: Per-course analytics
analytics.description: Enrollment counts, completion rate, median progress and a 30-day enrollment trend chart.

dashboard.title: Learner dashboard
dashboard.description: The /dashboard page aggregates in-progress courses, certificates, pending quizzes and the catalog.

platform.title: Production-ready infrastructure
platform.intro: Everything that makes the platform reliable, multilingual and observable, day in and day out.

auth.title: JWT auth and email confirm
auth.description: Secure registration, email confirmation and password reset flows.

magicLink.title: Magic-link login
magicLink.description: Passwordless authentication: a signed link received by email is enough to sign in.

notificationPrefs.title: Notification preferences
notificationPrefs.description: Each user picks which emails they receive, by category (join requests, invitations, transfers).

multilingual.title: Multilingual UI
multilingual.description: Five languages on the interface: FR, EN, NL, IT, ES.

outbox.title: Outbox + Celery
outbox.description: Reliable async delivery with retry and backoff. SMTP or Microsoft Graph.

dashboard.title: Admin dashboard
dashboard.description: Chart.js KPIs: active users, domains, questions and sessions.

diagnostics.title: System diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Live snapshot of DB, email, upload and DeepL config with on-demand checks.

rateLimit.title: Rate limiting
rateLimit.description: Public and sensitive endpoints protected via ScopedRateThrottle.

api.title: OpenAPI client
api.description: drf-spectacular schema with auto-generated TypeScript client.

about.companyIntro: Legal information and contact details of the company that operates QuizOnline.
about.legalIntro: QuizOnline complies with European regulations on personal data protection.

legalSections.title: Data controller
content: The data controller is the administrator of the deployed QuizOnline instance.
For any question regarding your personal data, contact the administrator of your instance.

legalSections.title: Data collected
content: Identification data: username, email address, first name, last name.
Activity data: quiz answers, scores, sessions, language preferences.
Technical data: connection logs strictly necessary for security.

legalSections.title: Legal basis and purposes (GDPR Art. 6)
content: Performance of a contract: managing your account, taking quizzes and tracking your results.
Legitimate interest: platform security, abuse prevention, service improvement.
Consent: sending optional notifications (revocable at any time).

legalSections.title: Your rights (GDPR Art. 15-22)
content: Right of access: obtain a copy of your personal data.
Right to rectification: correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
Right to erasure: request the deletion of your data.
Right to data portability: receive your data in a structured, readable format.
Right to object: object to processing in certain cases.
Right to lodge a complaint: file a complaint with your national supervisory authority.

legalSections.title: Data retention
content: Account data is retained for the duration of your registration.
Session and result data is retained as long as the domain is active.
Upon account deletion, your personal data is deleted or anonymized within 30 days.

legalSections.title: Security
content: Communications are encrypted via HTTPS/TLS.
Passwords are hashed using an irreversible algorithm (PBKDF2).
Authentication relies on short-lived JWT tokens.

legalSections.title: Cookies
content: QuizOnline does not use tracking cookies or advertising cookies.
Only strictly necessary technical cookies (session, language preference) are used.

about.technicalIntro: The project is organized as a monorepo with an Angular frontend, a Django REST backend and a shared OpenAPI contract.

repository.title: Repository
repository.description: Source code, CI and contract artifacts live in the same repository.
items: GitHub monorepo for frontend, backend and synchronization scripts.
